summary:
Main
Iron ore futures, most Qingdao port spot products and seaborne quotes pulled back slightly in tandem today. DCE most-traded closedat 657.0 yuan/mt, down 0.23% from Nov 24. Seven of the eight Qingdao spot products softened while one rose: Newman Lump dropped 20 yuan to 778 yuan/wmt, Carajas Fines fell 6 yuan to 780 yuan/wmt, and PB Fines, Mac Fines, BRBF, SSF and PB Lump each slipped 3 yuan, whereas Newman Fines rose 3 yuan to 636 yuan/wmt.
